metadata.source: HYG Database v4.4 (stars, commit 53e3df3) + ConstellationLines v1.4 (lines, commit 158ea7c)
metadata.license: Stars: CC BY-SA 4.0. Constellation lines: CC BY 4.0. The combined stars.json is a derived database distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
metadata.attribution: Star data: HYG Database v4.4, David Nash / Astronomy Nexus, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://codeberg.org/astronexus/hyg). Based partly on Hipparcos (ESA). Constellation lines: Marc van der Sluys, ConstellationLines v1.4, CC BY 4.0 (https://github.com/MarcvdSluys/ConstellationLines, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23210182). Changes: filtered stars to V < 5, converted to JSON, joined BSC HR line vertices to J2000 RA/Dec.
metadata.constellationSource: Marc van der Sluys, ConstellationLines v1.4 (BSC HR vertex lists)
metadata.notes: J2000 RA/Dec in degrees. Stars are filtered to apparent magnitude < 5; constellation line vertices are joined from the full HYG table so faint line endpoints are preserved. 9 BSC HR vertices (of 840) are absent from HYG v4.4; lines are split at those vertices rather than bridged.
